title: Conditional κ = 0.001292099559442278: R715 shared kernel, target mixing and whole hosting
body:
Conditional **κ = 0.001292099559442278**, exactly `646049779721139/500000000000000000`, **1.4180932604% above #458**. The bit side binds; the paid-adapter complex supplier is unchanged.

Starting from #463's published R715 word, reconstruct 109 shared-donor pivots (entrance rank 120), 56 disjoint target mixes, 60 single-gate retimings and #467's 14 paired retimings. Pool eight replicas, keeping each of the 62,920 residual occurrences whole on one idle physical family. The exact bit lower endpoint is `0.001293771240692396056124`, with 9,600 live and 9,609 physical families.

The physical-family growth bound is recomputed independently. Its 804-bit prefix is charged at 832 bits, and the 2,468-bit three-level coefficient at 2,496 in every bootstrap cutoff. The bit row coefficient remains 19,431, below the retained 20,161 contract.

Verification covers exact reconstruction; all local and unbanked global columns; fresh C++ legality and eleven-stage columns; record and mixing mutations; Gram matrices and target labels; residual isometries and projectors; every owner, window, slot and remainder; the renamed instruction stream; physical-prefix accounting; both rational moment engines; six bootstrap steps and all 47 strict outer inequalities. Adjacent-grid and invalid-parameter controls are rejected.

Release evidence includes a full Linux replay and a macOS component replay with an explicitly reused, freshly completed and manifest-matching Python 3.11 full parent. The entire final RESULT.json matches across platforms. All 16 repository joint tests pass. GitHub CI remains separate and pending.

Run `E8_REPLAY_PHASES=1 python -B research/e8-r715-whole-hosted/verify.py /absolute/new/output`. Default mode replays the complete corrected #458 chain. Explicit `--parent-output` reuse emits a distinct receipt status. Source hashes, proof, receipts and Python 3.11/3.14 CI are included.

All inherited compiler, mutable-basis/target-label, whole-call correlated-helper hosting, compressed-window, restored-work, common-grid/tape, precision, row and analytic contracts remain. No residual is split across physical families. This is a conditional finite composition; κ = 1, global optimality and an unconditional multiplication theorem remain unproved.

New selection, integration and release by chafreaky with OpenAI Codex. Original sources, notices and licenses retained.
